transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us together for our final planning huddle on the Film & Food Night activation in the courtyard. Before I can authorize this to go public, I need to hear from our rights counsel and operations manager — each of you needs to report your completed review of the current draft. As a reminder, the draft has the headline sponsor on a freestanding logo wall, participating food brands displaying their marks, and buffet service from two tables. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report my review findings. Yesterday I reviewed the signed sponsor agreement with the sponsor's legal team and confirmed that the sponsor may appear only on reusable event cups and the festival website. The agreement prohibits a freestanding logo wall and prohibits competitor product marks in the activation area. I have not yet entered this result in the activation file.

transcript.text: I need to report my operations review findings. This morning I confirmed with the municipal health inspector that the permit requires individually prepackaged food, exactly three service stations, and an allergen placard at every station. I haven't updated the operating draft yet because the inspector's confirmation came in after the draft was circulated. So the current draft's two-table buffet setup doesn't meet permit requirements — we need three stations with prepackaged food and allergen placards.
